provider_receipt.summary: Review found unsupported completion and named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-89 MemoryStore::store serializes each MemoryRecord and immediately discards it, so scan_vault does not provide the claimed persistent-memory integration; (2) src/lib.rs:184-192 resolves slash-containing wikilinks with an unchecked PathBuf::join and accepts absolute or parent-traversal paths, allowing links to resolve outside the private vault and disclose external path existence; (3) src/lib.rs:110-113 silently drops WalkDir errors, permitting incomplete scans to report success; (4) src/lib.rs:13-25 cannot deserialize the active ingestion contract documented at docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-93 because required governance/privacy fields are absent and confidence is modeled as u8 rather than low/medium/high. Existing tests cover only ordinary links and a missing vault path, not these failure or security cases. The supplied durable evidence establishes only a clean tree and close-receipt lineage; it does not substantiate functional, contract, security, or privacy correctness.
